supersedes.scope: External independent-review gates and review-record bindings only. All least-privilege, isolation, provenance, replay, receipt, timeout, cancellation, and rollback controls remain in force.

operator_policy.implementation_loop: implement -> exact-head CI/adversarial self-review -> fix -> continue
operator_policy.live_activation: requires validated host-specific installation evidence and explicit operator activation authority

invariants: workspace-shell-exec is a hostile repository-code principal distinct from frontend/tunnel/root services
worker has no tunnel/frontend/broker/job-launcher credentials or control sockets
ordinary execution is limited to the frozen profile grammar and exact task/source binding
root broker never accepts generic root argv, shell, sudo, package-manager, or systemctl authority
Heartbeat remains separate and receives no Workspace Shell execution authority

unprivileged_execution.source_policy: git-read may inspect a dirty exact-SHA checkout; profiles that execute repository code require clean source and disposable scratch copy
unprivileged_execution.cancellation: caller disconnect/timeout terminates the transient cgroup and verifies cleanup

privileged_approval.issuer: operator-controlled Ed25519 signer outside Lambda and outside ChatGPT/MCP/tunnel/frontend/worker/broker identities
enforcement: root broker verifies frontend SO_PEERCRED and frontend Ed25519 request signature
root broker independently verifies operator approval signature against root-owned trust/revocation stores
approval ID, nonce, and idempotency key are consumed durably before mutation
helper registry, helper entry, helper bytes, parameters, source commit and source tree are recomputed and exact-bound
registered helper must be enabled and executes inside a bounded transient cgroup with declared confinement

receipts.output: bounded returned bytes with full-stream SHA256 and observed byte counts

required_before_apply: distinct UID/GID and path collision checks
dedicated tunnel identity and mTLS material distinct from Heartbeat
